desc:
⛏️ BLOCKLIFE ⛏️
Lucky blocks, an endless world, and gear that glows.

Crack open lucky blocks for loot, enchanted drops and surprises. Dig, build and survive your way from a wooden pickaxe all the way up to Rainbowite.

🍀 Lucky blocks hidden all over the world
🌍 Endless world: villages, cherry groves, mountains and deep caves
⚒️ 8 tool tiers, plus Seraph, Tempest, Infernal and Eclipse gear
🔥 Open a portal to the Cinderlands: Boarkin, Tuskers, Wailers, Ember Wisps and Cinderite gear
✨ Enchanting table and anvil
🐴 Tame horses and wolves
🌾 Farm, cook and craft, with a recipe book to help
🧟 Zombies, skeletons, spiders and Boomlings come out at night
🛏️ Beds set your spawn
🎁 Daily and playtime rewards, plus a free group kit
❤️ Lifeward Charm: a second chance when you die

⭐ Like and favourite to get every update! ⭐
